findings.explanation: The eleven-word roof-and-house clause is a source-specific extended analogy, not a conventional set phrase. Although understandable, the seven tasks force its exact wording into a clinic, school, bakery, library, port and pantry; most assess the same continuing-service-during-upgrade decision. It risks teaching a one-off image as a reusable fixed expression. The hold reason itself asks for this naturalness gate.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep source 4596 on editorial hold unless the owner explicitly accepts this as a creative figurative-use lesson after a naturalness/transfer review. A release candidate would need a genuinely reusable pattern and more distinct decisions without requiring students to repeat the entire bespoke clause.

findings.explanation: The exact source says visitors want a local experience they cannot copy and paste from another city: the non-replicable, place-specific side of the metaphor. The draft teaches only the criticism of copying plans from elsewhere without adaptation. That is related but leaves the source’s affirmative uniqueness sense unassessed and narrows the meaning too far.
findings.recommendedFix: Broaden the brief to cover exact replication and its limits, then add at least one grounded assessed case where a distinctive local experience cannot simply be copied elsewhere. Retain the literal-computer-editing boundary, adaptation examples, and a precise Chinese rendering; avoid claiming all borrowing is wrong.

findings.explanation: Both steps reuse the cafe copying another city’s menu and overlooking local dietary needs, contrary to SOP setting rotation.
findings.recommendedFix: Move the speaking model to a different institution and local constraint while preserving the figurative target and recalculating the target span.

findings.explanation: Three assessed contexts cluster around a working caregiver or shift-working parent with scarce time. The source itself names working parents, so the lesson offers limited transfer beyond that one demographic.
findings.recommendedFix: Replace one of the three contexts with a different bounded scarcity of time, such as a volunteer team’s brief morning setup window, without implying wealth or absolute unavailability.
